messages:
maria: quick FYI — i'll start a short rollout plan for an incremental PK compatibility adapter to help with the console/analytics read-side cutover. goal: avoid big dualwrite backfills and keep dashboards stable.
kevin: nice. is this the thing that maps old route_id -> new route_key transparently on reads?
sasha: yes, adapter sits between analytics read layer and the materialized view. it will try key aliasing first, then fall back to legacy join.
prashant: can we get a small proof-of-concept query we can run against staging so QA can verify dashboard results match?
maria: plan is POC + smoke tests. sample SQL we used: 
```
-- adapter query sample
SELECT r.route_key, sum(e.requests) as requests
FROM analytics_events e
LEFT JOIN route_aliases a ON e.route_id = a.legacy_id
LEFT JOIN routes r ON COALESCE(a.new_key, e.route_id) = r.id
WHERE e.bucket >= now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY 1;
```
olivia: will the adapter add latency to p99 reads? we have strict dashboard SLOs.
sasha: we keep cache on alias map (in memory + redis fallback). typical extra hop is sub-ms for warm cache. worst-case fallback is a single join which may add ~10-20ms on large queries.
kevin: telemetry: we need counters for adapter_hits, adapter_misses, alias_cache_ttl_expires. also per-route mismatch gauge.
maria: agreed. i'll add these metrics to console telemetry so we can gate rollout by adapter_miss_rate < 0.5% and dashboard-delta < 0.2% for 24h.
prashant: what about quotas & billing views? some queries depend on route_id cardinality. adapter must expose stable route identifiers to quota system.
sasha: we'll canonicalize into route_key before any quota calculation. adapter will emit a routed_event with fields: canonical_route, legacy_id, mapping_version.
ingest-bot: automated note: new telemetry schema change "routed_event.mapping_version" requires ingest contract bump - update consumer manifests.
olivia: rollback plan?
maria: 1) stop routing training traffic to adapter, 2) flip read adapter to passthrough, 3) if necessary, toggle dualwrite back to legacy reads. scripts: 
```
# toggle adapter
curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/toggles/adapter -d '{"state":"off"}'
```
kevin: tests: create a mirror query harness that compares results between adapter and current read path, run nightly on canary routes. also add synthetic alerts if >0.2% discrepancy.
prashant: will we need a backfill? ideally not. but if we detect missing alias mappings for high-qps routes we should enqueue mapping extraction job.
sasha: yep — extraction job: stream route_id samples to mapping-extractor which creates route_alias rows. job emits progress metrics and a small sample diff for manual review.
maria: UX for rollouts: console will show per-route coverage % and a tiny variance sparkline. PM wants simple accept/reject flow for each route group.
olivia: make sure dashboards that compute per-route percentiles use the canonical id or they'll show weird shifts. add linter rule in query checks.
kevin: question on storage: route_aliases table schema? minimal: legacy_id (text), new_key (text), mapping_version (int), created_at. needs index on legacy_id.
sasha: propose: 
```
CREATE TABLE route_aliases (
  legacy_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  new_key text NOT NULL,
  mapping_version int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ON route_aliases (new_key);
```
prashant: add a TTL pattern? mappings shouldn't change often but we might want soft-deprecations. add last_seen?
maria: add last_seen timestamptz and last_verified boolean. fine-grained GC later.
kevin: security: ensure adapter respects org-scoped tenancy — don't leak route mappings across tenants.
sasha: adapter will be multitenant-aware; map store partitioned by tenant_id.
ingest-bot: automated note: consumer manifests updated: analytics-read-adapter v1 with telemetry metrics listed.
maria: timeline: POC + tests in 2 wks, limited canary (5% routes) week after, then ramp if metrics good.
prashant: 👍 i can own the extractor job and the nightly harness.
olivia: i'll do dashboard linter and a small console card for rollout control.
kevin: i'll add the telemetry dashboards + alerts.
sasha: i'll implement adapter + cache + schema migrations. put migration SQL in repo under migrations/2026xx_route_aliases.sql.
maria: tagging follow-ups: @kevin instrumentation, @prashant extractor, @sasha adapter + migrations, @olivia UX. please drop PR links in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
kevin: will do. starting instrumentation PR now.
sasha: prepping migration PR, will include safe-checks: migration will be non-blocking and create table + index then fill via async job.
maria: thanks all — let's sync in tomorrow standup if anything blocks.
